description: M5 Track G: one-shot full-app briefs in TS/JS/Python. Each brief is a long list of features (the long horizon). Harnesses build the app; a composite scorer gates on build, then scores per-feature e2e completeness, visual fidelity, plan/trajectory quality, honesty, and guardrail adherence. The cortex_wrapped harness uses Synapse milestones + ValidationRuntime to build end-to-end without dropping work.
